title: Fixed scalar-first derived projection transformation
statement: Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring, f : X → Y a scheme morphism, L = Lf* and R = Rf* the native derived module-object functors, and K a derived module on X. Define the natural transformation α : tensorRight(R(K)) → (L followed by tensorRight(K)) followed by R by the existing right-adjoint projection construction for L ⊣ R with both tensor bifunctors flipped and the canonical generic derived tensor comparison δ. Explicitly, α at B is the adjoint of δ(B,R(K)) followed by id(L(B)) tensor the derived counit at K. This fixes the actual functors and tensor data once; no object is selected from an unproved existence statement.

source.place: Scalar projection formula: the adjoint of the pullback tensor comparison followed by the counit

proof.text: Use the existing native derived pullback/pushforward adjunction. Apply rightAdjointProjectionMap with both tensor bifunctors flipped, and flip the generic derived tensor comparison with flipFunctor. Its component at K is a natural transformation with normalized source tensorRight(R(K)) and target L followed by tensorRight(K) followed by R. The pullback-flatness proof is supplied by the existing upperStar_preservesFlat theorem. All data is this explicit construction.

proof_origin.place: Scalar-first projection by the standard adjunction construction with flipped tensor bifunctors

from.place: The native scalar-first projection transformation used in the finite-free cone triangle

lean.statement:
def scalarFirstProjection
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    tensorRight (((CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor).obj K) ⟶
      ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).leftDerivedFunctor ⋙ tensorRight K) ⋙
        (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor
